question: Who laid the foundation of school of possibilism?
text: French geographer **Paul Vidal de la Blache** laid the foundation of the school of possibilism in human geography. French historian **Lucien Febvre** later coined the term *possibilism*. ([bsgi.it](https://bsgi.it/index.php/bsgi/article/view/542?utm_source=openai))
